Road Safety - Electronic Monitoring and Enforcement System (EMES) - Notification of Designated Authority under Rule 167A(1) of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 - Preamble
GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
ABSTRACT
TR&B Department – Road Safety - Electronic Monitoring and Enforcement
System (EMES) – Notification of Designated Authority, under Rule 167A(1) of the
Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, in compliance with directions of the Hon'ble
Supreme Court of India in W.P.(C) No. 295 of 2012 (S. Rajaseekaran v. Union of
India) – Orders – Issued.
=========================================
TRANSPORT, ROADS & BUILDINGS (TR.I) DEPARTMENT
G.O.Ms.No. 32 Dated: 30-06-2026

Road Safety - Electronic Monitoring and Enforcement System (EMES) - Notification of Designated Authority under Rule 167A(1) of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 - Order
O R D E R:
In the reference 1st read above, Rule 167A of the Central Motor Vehicles
Rules, 1989, was inserted by the Central Motor Vehicles(Seventeenth
Amendment) Rules, 2021, notified vide G.S.R. 575(E) dated 11.08.2021. Sub-rule
(1) of Rule 167A mandates that every electronic enforcement device used for
issuance of challans shall have an approval certificate issued by a Designated
Authority notified by the State Government, certifying that the device is accurate
and operating properly, and that the said approval certificate shall be renewed
on a yearly basis.

Road Safety - Electronic Monitoring and Enforcement System (EMES) - Notification of Designated Authority under Rule 167A(1) of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 - Paragraph 2 - In the reference 2nd & 3rd read above, the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India,
2. In the reference 2nd & 3rd read above, the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India,
in W.P.(C) No. 295 of 2012 (S. Rajaseekaran v. Union of India),vide its orders
dated 02.09.2024 and 07.10.2025 has directed all State Governments to
immediately take steps to implement the provisions of Section 136A of the Motor
Vehicles Act, 1988, read with Rule 167A of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989,
including compliance with sub-rule (1) thereof requiring notification of a
Designated Authority.

3. In the reference 5th read above, the Transport Commissioner, Telangana
has proposed the constitution of a multi-departmental Designated Authority for
the purpose of examination, certification, and annual renewal of approval
certificates for electronic enforcement devices used for issuance of challans
under Rule 167A of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, in the State of
Telangana.

Road Safety - Electronic Monitoring and Enforcement System (EMES) - Notification of Designated Authority under Rule 167A(1) of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 - Paragraph 4 - The Government, after careful examination of the proposal of the
4. The Government, after careful examination of the proposal of the
Transport Commissioner, Telangana, hereby constitute and notify the following
multi-departmental authority as the "Designated Authority" for the State of
Telangana, for the purposes of Rule 167A(1) of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, :
(i) Transport Commissioner, Telangana – Chairperson
(ii) A Senior Officer with experience in traffic rules enforcement,
nominated by the Director General of Police, Telangana –Member
(iii) A Senior Officer nominated by the ITE&C Department,
Government of Telangana – Member
(iv) A Senior Officer from Telangana Technology Services Limited
(TGTS), nominated by the Managing Director, TGTS–
Member
(v) | A | Senior | Officer | from | the | Department | of | Legal | Metrology,
nominated | by | the | Head | of | Department, | Legal | Metrology–
Member
(vi) A Faculty Member from the Department of Electrical / Electronic
Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Hyderabad, co-
opted by the Transport Commissioner, Telangana – Member

Road Safety - Electronic Monitoring and Enforcement System (EMES) - Notification of Designated Authority under Rule 167A(1) of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 - Paragraph 5 - The Designated Authority so constituted shall be empowered to:
5. The Designated Authority so constituted shall be empowered to:
(i) Examine and certify that electronic enforcement devices proposed
to be deployed for issuance of challans in the State of Telangana
are accurate and operating properly, in accordance with
Rule167A(1) of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989;
(ii) Issue approval certificates in respect of such devices; and
(iii) Renew approval certificates on a yearly basis, as required under
Rule 167A(1) of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989.

6. The Designated Authority shall devise its own procedure for examination
and certification of electronic enforcement devices, consistent with the
provisions of Rule 167A of the Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989, and the
technical standards prescribed by the Ministry of Road Transport & Highways,
Government of India, from time to time.
